data.name: Richard
data.gender_notes: Richard is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Richard is derived from the Old High German name "Ricard", which means 'ruler of the people'. It was popularized by Charlemagne, who ruled the Franks (a Germanic people) in the late 8th and early 9th centuries and was known as "Richard the Great". In Christian tradition, the name Richard is associated with strength, courage, and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who aspires to be a leader in his community and to rule with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Richard belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Richard total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Richard has a rich cultural heritage, having been borne by many notable figures throughout history. It was a common name among European monarchs, including kings of England, France, and Germany. Richard the Lionheart, King of England from 1189 to 1199, is perhaps the most famous bearer of the name. He earned his nickname due to his bravery and skill in battle, as well as his leadership abilities. The name Richard has since been associated with strength, courage, and noble birth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Richard holds a spiritual significance as a reminder of God's calling for His people to be leaders and rulers in His kingdom. The name inspires us to strive for inner strength and courage, to be faithful servants and leaders in our communities, and to trust in God's guidance and protection in all endeavors. As Christians, we are called to be "rulers of God's people," following the example of Jesus, who came to serve, not to be served (Matthew 20:28). May the name Richard be a daily reminder to live out this calling with courage, humility, and faithfulness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Richard, derived from the Germanic name 'Richardus', means 'Powerful ruler'. It symbolizes strength, leadership, and the ability to govern wisely. Spiritually, it represents the individual's commitment to be a bold and effective leader in their faith journey.

historical_references.context: Richard III was the last king of the House of Plantagenet. He ruled England from 1483 until his death in battle in 1485. Despite his military skills and initial popularity, his reign was marked by political instability and his death in the Battle of Bosworth led to the end of the Plantagenet line.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Richard' has modern context in various professional and business-related circles. Richard Branson, the British entrepreneur and business magnate, is a notable person with this name. He is known for founding the Virgin Group, which controls more than 400 companies. He is also active in philanthropy. Another Richard, namely Richard Stallman, is the founder of the free software movement and the GNU Project. He is known for his advocacy of software freedom. Both these individuals are influential figures in their respective fields and are frequently discussed on professional networking sites like LinkedIn, business news platforms like Forbes, and business data platforms like Crunchbase.
